summary: Addex Therapeutics Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 25, 2026, attaching a press release announcing it regained full global rights to all GABAB positive allosteric modulator assets discovered under its research collaboration with Indivior UK Limited. The reversion follows Indivior's R&D rationalization and the announced planned merger of Indivior's parent with Supernus Pharmaceuticals. No consideration, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or timeline terms were disclosed. This is a routine asset-rights reversion, not a special situation; the arb angle is nil, though pipeline ownership clarity may matter to Addex holders.
